items.title: Cincinnati Financial’s (NASDAQ:CINF) Q2 CY2026: Sales Beat Estimates due to Investment Gains
items.summary: Property casualty insurer Cincinnati Financial (NASDAQ:CINF) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 54% year on year to $4.27 billion due to a large jump in investment gains. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.43 per share was 21.3% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
